notes.title: Jeziorne - Kolonia Demo update
notes.content:
[h1]We're changing for you[/h1]
[p]We've just pushed out a patch to the demo with fixes you've brought to our attention. Some of the major things this patch addresses are:[/p][list][*][p]top-down section (kayak rental) related bugs fixes,[/p][/*][*][p]TPP walk speed increased,[/p][/*][*][p]added Credits,[/p][/*][*][p]added missing sound effects,[/p][/*][*][p]removed a couple pickup items,[/p][/*][*][p]fixed a couple soft locks and edge-case crashes,[/p][/*][/list][p]and many more![/p][h3]
We’re working hard on addressing complaints about camera (testings two new modes), melee combat and inventory management.

[/h3][h1]More languages[/h1][p]We've added language support (dialogues and UI) for the following:[/p][list][*][p]Simplified Chinese,[/p][/*][*][p]French,[/p][/*][*][p]German,[/p][/*][*][p]Japanese.
[/p][/*][/list][p]We’ll also add these languages by the end of next week:[/p][list][*][p]Portuguese,[/p][/*][*][p]Brazilian Portuguese,[/p][/*][*][p]Russian,[/p][/*][*][p]Spanish,[/p][/*][*][p]Latin America Spanish,[/p][/*][*][p]Turkish,[/p][/*][*][p]Ukrainian.
[/p][/*][/list][h1]Thank you!!![/h1][p]A big thank you to everyone who has played the demo so far! The reception has been incredible, and we're sitting at overwhelmingly positive 96% on Steam with it. 

If you think that what we're creating here is something special, please share our demo with any friends or online communities you are part of. It helps us immensely. We've always believed that putting a game into the hands of players to get feedback and also have the game speak for itself is the best thing any indie game dev can do so the more we get onboard, the higher we can go with this pixel abomination of ours.

With love,
Sonka

[url=https://discord.gg/At6jX9tphU][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43338400/ce95c48d5882df8fe1fea2d8829cb923a568d252.png"][/img][/url]

notes.title: The Final Demo Is Out Right Now
notes.content:
[p]We’ve got a wonderfully foul surprise for you! As part of Summer Games Fest, [b]we’re shadow dropping our brand new demo for Holstin… RIGHT NOW![/b]

A big shout out to Future Games for having us and our little surprise as part of their show in Los Angeles!

[/p][h2][b]Experience The First 2 Hours of Holstin[/b][/h2][p]
You read that right. The new demo lets you experience [b]the first two hours of the full game. [/b]

Step into the town of Jeziorne-Kolonia and get a proper feel of how everything we’ve been working on finally comes together - combat, story, puzzles, camera tricks, and of course a town absolutely drenched in 90’s Polish vibes… [i]and ooze[/i].

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2443020/Holstin_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2][b]Extensive Demo Gameplay Trailer[/b][/h2][p]
To go along with the demo drop, we’ve released a brand new trailer. Give it a play if you want a dirty little peek at what’s in store for you.

[/p][previewyoutube="0O3ofy7-iFY;full"][/previewyoutube][h2][b]More [strike]Tongues[/strike] Languages To Come[/b][/h2][p]
Right now the demo has full Polish voiceover with English, Polish, Italian, and Finnish subtitles.Rest assured, we’re working on getting more subtitles in as quickly as possible. 

[b]By June 10th,[/b] we should be able to add:
[/p][list][*][p]German[/p][/*][*][p]French[/p][/*][*][p]Japanese[/p][/*][*][p]Simplified Chinese[/p][/*][/list][p]And hopefully [b]by the end of June we will add: [/b][/p][list][*][p]Ukrainian[/p][/*][*][p]Turkisk[/p][/*][*][p]Russian[/p][/*][*][p]Portuguese + Brazilian Portuguese[/p][/*][*][p]Spanish + Latin America Spanish[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Our Kickstarter is Still Growing[/b][/h2][p]
For those wondering, yes! The Kickstarter campaign is still on its way. If you want exclusive rewards and a chance to shape the future of Holstin, be sure to sign up to be notified the moment it goes live. We’ve got plenty of ideas for rewards and initiatives that you'll be able to grab, but for now, here’s the teaser page: 

[/p][h3][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sonkagames/holstin"]➡️https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sonkagames/holstin⬅️[/url][/h3][p]
Click that [b]"Notify me on launch" button[/b] so you can be the first to know when we launch our full campaign and secure your limited early bird rewards. [b]It helps us a ton.[/b]

See you on the streets of Jeziorne-Kolonia!

- Sonka

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43338400/ce95c48d5882df8fe1fea2d8829cb923a568d252.png"][/img]
[/p]

notes.title: Major Demo Update For Steam Scream Fest
notes.content:
Over the last few weeks, we've been making some changes to the game and demo, a lot of which is thanks to your feedback.

So in tandem with The Steam Scream Fest, [b]we've just released an update to the demo. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43338400/8b8154825a28b44731e285d2cf133f4d534c6e1c.gif[/img]

[b][h2]Patch Notes[/h2][/b]
[h3][b]New Languages[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Chinese (Simplified)
[*] Finnish
[*] French
[*] German
[*] Japanese
[*] Portuguese
[*] Portuguese (Brazil)
[*] Ukrainian
[*] Russian
[*] Spanish
[*] Spanich (Latin America)
[*] Turkish[/list][h3][b]Stamina rework[/b][/h3]
While we're still working on stamina implementation, in the current version aiming [b]does not[/b] drain stamina.

[h3][b]Steam Deck Support[/b][/h3]
Multiple performance and UI tweaks for a better Steam Deck experience.

[h3][b]Gameplay Changes[/b][/h3][list]
[*] Aim assist is now off by default
[*] Herbs restore 40 stamina now
[*] Stomp no longer damages if dodged into
[*] Improved enemy pathfinding
[/list][h3][b]Performance[/b][/h3][list]
[*] Automatic performance improvement in case of low fps
[*] Multiple performance improvements
[/list][h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3][list]
[*] sometimes mouse pointer would stay visible in TPP mode
[*] multiple inventory items could be sharing the same slot if certain requirements are met
[*] QTE animation glitches fixed
[*] stomp animation issues
[*] UI glitches when quickly changing windows
[*] problems when returning from menu while aiming
[*] spikes area damage
[*] issues with ooze near doors
[*] toilet seat glitches
[*] issues with dragging sliders and closing windows
[*] collider issues on Broken Rack
[*] quick slots UI sometimes showed a wrong item when dragging it across quick slots
[/list][url=https://discord.gg/4RzT2vMjWv][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43338400/ce95c48d5882df8fe1fea2d8829cb923a568d252.png[/img][/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2235430/Holstin/

~ Sonka

notes.title: New Combat Demo and Gameplay Trailer
notes.content:
Hello fellow investigators.

We have some very exciting news from our team. 

[h2]We have launched an updated demo with our much-awaited combat gameplay.[/h2]

It took a little longer than we planned but that's because when we got down to it, we decided we wanted to do this right and with some extra flare to really add to the gameplay. What we finally managed to come up with and get working is in our opinion, quite cool. 

[h3]Check out our new trailer to see our combat in action [/h3]

[previewyoutube=CO0A1PNnXPY;full][/previewyoutube]

Of course, don't just take our word for it. Download the new demo and try it out yourselves! We'll be adding additional language support to part 2 in the next few days while part 1 has been translated for all the languages listed here on Steam.

If you'd like to get even more exclusive access to things we're doing with the game, join our Discord. We share a lot of work-in-progress stuff there and gather feedback from players.

[url=https://discord.gg/jre2qtMECg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43338400/ce95c48d5882df8fe1fea2d8829cb923a568d252.png[/img][/url]

See you down on the other side... hopefully.

[i]- Team Sonka[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2235430/Holstin/
